readme.markdown:
# DataEcho — agent skills

[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

Two [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) for the **[DataEcho](https://dataecho.ai)** platform:

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`dataecho`](skills/dataecho/SKILL.md) | **Deploy anything to a live URL in seconds** — a single file, a static site, or a full server-side app (any stack, via Dockerfile). Anonymous publish with a claim flow, incremental deploys, private Drives with scoped share tokens. |
| [`dataecho-memory`](skills/dataecho-memory/SKILL.md) | **Persistent memory for agents** — durable across sessions, machines, sandboxes, and platforms. A ~1 KB index + one fact per file on a private versioned drive; atomic concurrent-safe writes, full history/undo, one-command handoff to another agent. |

Both are plain `SKILL.md` + self-contained scripts (bash + python3 stdlib, zero dependencies), so they work in **any agent that supports the open Agent Skills format** — Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot / VS Code, Goose, opencode, Qwen Code, Amp, Cline, Kilo, Hermes, OpenClaw, and more.

## Install

```bash
# both skills, any supported agent (global; drop -g for project-local)
npx skills add mohocp/dataecho -g

# just one of them
npx skills add mohocp/dataecho --skill dataecho -g
npx skills add mohocp/dataecho --skill dataecho-memory -g
```

Claude Code plugin route:

```
/plugin marketplace add mohocp/dataecho
/plugin install dataecho@dataecho
```

No npm? Install the deploy helper scripts directly:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://dataecho.ai/install.sh | bash        # macOS / Linux
```
```powershell
irm https://dataecho.ai/install.ps1 | iex               # Windows PowerShell
```

## What's inside

- [`skills/dataecho/SKILL.md`](skills/dataecho/SKILL.md) — publish handshake, Dockerfile app contract, claim contract, Drives, API-key flow
  - [`scripts/publish.sh`](skills/dataecho/scripts/publish.sh) — 3-call publish (create → upload → finalize), incremental deploys, anonymous-claim handling
  - [`scripts/drive.sh`](skills/dataecho/scripts/drive.sh) — drive CRUD, import/export, scoped share tokens, ETag-safe writes
  - [`scripts/publish.ps1`](skills/dataecho/scripts/publish.ps1) — Windows PowerShell publisher
- [`skills/dataecho-memory/SKILL.md`](skills/dataecho-memory/SKILL.md) — the memory discipline (recall-first, update-don't-duplicate, forget-what's-wrong)
  - [`scripts/memory.sh`](skills/dataecho-memory/scripts/memory.sh) — `recall / remember / forget / reindex / history / restore / handoff`; every mutation commits fact + index in one atomic CAS batch

## Security & privacy

- **Credentials**: the API key (obtained via an email one-time code) is stored at `~/.artifact/credentials` (`chmod 600`), or passed via `$ARTIFACT_API_KEY`. Nothing else is written outside the project. Revoke keys any time from the [dashboard](https://dataecho.ai/dashboard).
- **Network**: scripts talk only to `https://dataecho.ai` (override: `$ARTIFACT_BASE_URL`). No telemetry, no third-party calls.
- **Anonymous publishes** need no account; they expire in 24 h unless claimed. Claim tokens are saved locally under `~/.artifact/claims/`.
- **Memory is private storage**, scoped to your account; share access is via revocable, prefix/TTL-scoped drive tokens. Don't store secrets in memories — it's not a vault.
- The `curl | bash` installer above is a convenience mirror of [`install.sh`](https://dataecho.ai/install.sh); the canonical scripts are versioned in this repo.

## Links

Docs: https://dataecho.ai/docs · Agent context: https://dataecho.ai/llms.txt · [llms-full.txt](https://dataecho.ai/llms-full.txt) · OpenAPI: https://dataecho.ai/openapi.json · Discovery: https://dataecho.ai/.well-known/agent.json

toolsPreview.name: platform_info
toolsPreview.description: DataEcho platform overview: what it can host, auth state of this connection, docs links. Call this first if unsure.

toolsPreview.name: request_login_code
toolsPreview.description: Start sign-in: email a one-time code to the user. Follow with verify_login_code.

toolsPreview.name: verify_login_code
toolsPreview.description: Complete sign-in with the emailed code. Returns the apiKey ONCE — configure it as the `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header of this MCP connection (and/or save to ~/.artifact/credentials for the CLI scripts). Never echo it into chat.

toolsPreview.name: publish_site
toolsPreview.description: Deploy files to a live URL. No slug → create a NEW site (works without auth; anonymous sites expire in 24h — always show the user the claimUrl). With slug → UPDATE that site (complete snapshot: send ALL files). A Dockerfile in the files makes it a server-side app (auth required; listen on process.env.PORT; persist under /data; poll app_status). Total payload ≤ 8 MB — for bigger sites use the dataecho skill scripts.

toolsPreview.name: claim_site
toolsPreview.description: Make a previously-anonymous site permanent under the authenticated account (requires auth + the claimToken from publish_site).

toolsPreview.name: list_sites
toolsPreview.description: List all sites owned by the authenticated account.

toolsPreview.name: search_sites
toolsPreview.description: Full-text search across the authenticated account's sites (names, metadata, and text content).

toolsPreview.name: get_site
toolsPreview.description: Full details + current file manifest of an owned site.

toolsPreview.name: update_site_metadata
toolsPreview.description: Patch site settings without redeploying: viewer title/description, SPA mode, TTL, password (string sets, null removes).

toolsPreview.name: delete_site
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete an owned site. Irreversible — confirm with the user first.

toolsPreview.name: app_status
toolsPreview.description: Build/run status of a container app deployed via publish_site with a Dockerfile. Poll until status is `live` or `failed`.

toolsPreview.name: list_drives
toolsPreview.description: List the authenticated account's private cloud drives.

toolsPreview.name: create_drive
toolsPreview.description: Create a new private drive.

toolsPreview.name: drive_list_files
toolsPreview.description: List files in a drive (by drive name or drv_… id), optionally under a path prefix.

toolsPreview.name: drive_read_file
toolsPreview.description: Read a file from a drive. Text comes back as utf-8 `content`; binary as `contentBase64`. Files over 1 MB are refused (use the skill scripts).

toolsPreview.name: drive_write_file
toolsPreview.description: Write/overwrite one file in a drive (ETag-safe: pass ifMatch to assert the version you read, otherwise the current version is used automatically).

toolsPreview.name: drive_delete_file
toolsPreview.description: Delete one file from a drive.

toolsPreview.name: drive_move_file
toolsPreview.description: Move/rename a file inside a drive.

toolsPreview.name: drive_share
toolsPreview.description: Mint a scoped drive access token for another agent (perms read|write, optional path prefix + TTL like `7d`). The secret is returned ONCE.

toolsPreview.name: drive_tokens
toolsPreview.description: List active share tokens of a drive (secrets are never shown again).

toolsPreview.name: drive_revoke_token
toolsPreview.description: Revoke a drive share token.

toolsPreview.name: drive_history
toolsPreview.description: Version timeline of a drive (every write is a restorable version).

toolsPreview.name: drive_restore
toolsPreview.description: Restore a drive to a prior version (commits a new version; nothing is lost).

toolsPreview.name: list_variables
toolsPreview.description: List account variable NAMES (values are write-only — they are injected into proxy calls and container apps, never read back).

toolsPreview.name: set_variable
toolsPreview.description: Create/update a write-only account secret (uppercase name). Injected as env vars into container apps and as ${VAR} into proxy calls. Optionally pin which upstream hosts may receive it.

toolsPreview.name: delete_variable
toolsPreview.description: Delete an account variable.
